E2.title: Wezlana Product Monograph
E2.text:
The study population were predominantly Caucasian (89%) and 51% were female. Median body 
weight was 61.6 kg, 56% had a body weight of between 50 and 70 kg and the median body mass 
index was 22.15 kg/m2. Median psoriasis duration was 5.29 years with median age at onset of 10 
years. The majority of subjects (70.0%) were 15 to 17 years of age, with a median age of 15.5 
years. 57% of subjects had ≥ 20% body surface area affected with psoriasis and median PASI 
score was 18.8 (range 12-51), and 62% and 38% of subjects had PGA scores of moderate and 
marked/severe respectively.
